canonical_project: Mayfield Energy Precinct - battery and data centre campus (Akaysha/Malabar)
notes: AltEnergy reports Akaysha and coal miner Malabar Resources plan the Mayfield Energy Precinct near Denman within Muswellbrook LGA, co-locating a data centre campus with IT capacity of up to 1 GW and a BESS of up to 2 GW/8 GWh. Newcastle Herald reports the ~A$10 billion proposal (Australia's largest battery at 2 GW) with a scoping report expected for NSW Planning; the Denman BESS (2.4 GW/4.8 GWh) is separately lodged as SSD on the Planning Portal. Inkl (2026-06) reports the campus is pitched to house Google/Microsoft workloads (unverified customer claim). Capacity 1000 MW = planned ultimate IT capacity, not approved/built.
